quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass 2025 revenue by product: quartz glass materials RMB 1,258,460,630.29 (62.41% of revenue, up 19.86%), gross margin 56.63%; quartz glass products RMB 752,387,124.32 (37.32%, up 14.62%), gross margin 32.05%. Domestic revenue RMB 1,438,516,157.00 (up 21.61%); overseas RMB 577,832,726.02 (28.66% of revenue, up 3.38%). The report says AI and other emerging fields lifted the semiconductor cycle; the company set up an overseas office, orders from leading customers grew steadily and semiconductor revenue grew steadily as it deepened cooperation with domestic equipment makers; aerospace demand kept recovering; optical-communication revenue rose year on year as AI compute improved that market, with sales of quartz glass product category one up 30.79% to 1,442.11 tons on AI-driven optical-communication demand; photovoltaic demand fell, cutting sales of quartz glass product category two by 34.43% and quartz glass material category one by 18.49%. Subsidiary Shanghai Feilihua Shichuang (quartz glass parts) had a net loss of RMB 77,339,850.45 on revenue of RMB 407,331,391.31.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass quartz electronic cloth (2025 annual report): quartz electronic cloth sales were RMB 9,837.37 ten-thousand in 2025; the ultra-thin quartz electronic cloth is in small-batch customer testing and end-customer certification. The R&D table says the ultra-thin cloth's dielectric and expansion properties reach an internationally leading level and it has achieved sales, and that its quartz electronic yarn has batch-supply capability and has achieved sales. The company says it has developed a group of global CCL customers and built stable cooperation with well-known international downstream companies. Subsidiary Jiangsu Zhongyi New Materials (electronic special materials and glass fibre) earned net profit of RMB 46,531,035.54 on revenue of RMB 246,088,392.36.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass capacity (2025 annual report): synthetic quartz material phase five was completed and put into production, adding 150 tons of capacity, and phase-six planning started; the Hefei Guangwei photomask-substrate precision-processing project began small-batch shipments; the Jinan Guangwei high-end electronic special-materials precision-processing project completed its basic-specification mass-production line and is optimising the mass-production process; the Dingyi New Materials and Zhongyi New Materials electronic fibre yarn and ultra-thin quartz electronic cloth projects started construction, with the company saying it will plan, build and release capacity in line with the market. It set up subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Malaysia for overseas production and trade.

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass outlook (2025 annual report, company plan): in the 15th Five-Year Plan period it aims to rank at the front of global sales scale for quartz materials in the semiconductor and optical fields, bring its quartz parts processing into the industry's leading tier as a strategic supplier to original equipment makers, keep its leading position in aerospace quartz fibre and consolidate its global competitive edge in electronic cloth; it treats electronic circuits and optics as new growth areas for a second growth curve and plans to make synthetic sand industrial to secure key raw materials. 2026 plan: more R&D on semiconductor, aerospace, electronic-circuit and optical technologies and deeper cooperation with downstream customers. Risk stated: the quartz electronic cloth project is in small-batch customer testing and end-customer certification, so business cooperation and orders are uncertain because of customer product iteration and fit testing.
